title: galium anglicum var. genuinum
intro: Galium anglicum var. genuinum, commonly known as English bedstraw, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include relieving digestive issues and inflammation, and it has been employed to treat conditions such as diarrhea, fever, and rheumatism. The therapeutic actions of Galium anglicum var. genuinum are attributed to its ability to act as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
